sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca yathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve parākrāntā jigīṣavaḥ tathaivābhisarās teṣāṃ tyaktātmāno jaye dhṛtāḥ
english: Dhritarashtra said: Just as all the Pandavas are valiant and desirous of victory, so too their allies, having abandoned concern for their own lives, are firmly committed to their triumph.

sanskrit: tvam eva hi parākrāntān ācakṣīthāḥ parān mama pāñcālān kekayān matsyān māgadhān vatsabhūmipān
english: You yourself have described to me the valiant enemies — the Panchalas, the Kekayas, the Matsyas, the Magadhas, and the lords of the Vatsa country.

sanskrit: yaś ca sendrān imāṃl lokān icchan kuryād vaśe balī sa śreṣṭho jagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ jaye dhṛtaḥ
english: And that mighty one who, desiring to bring under his sway these worlds together with Indra, is the foremost of the universe — Krishna — is devoted to the victory of the Pandavas.

sanskrit: samastām arjunād vidyāṃ sātyakiḥ kṣipram āptavān śaineyaḥ samare sthātā bījavat pravapañ śarān
english: Satyaki, the grandson of Shini, quickly mastered the entire science of arms from Arjuna; he stands firm in battle, scattering arrows like seeds being sown.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pāñcālyaḥ krūrakarmā mahārathaḥ māmakeṣu raṇaṃ kartā baleṣu paramāstravit
english: And Dhrishtadyumna of the Panchalas, cruel in his deeds and a great warrior, will wreak havoc upon my forces in battle — he is a supreme master of weapons.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhirasya ca krodhād arjunasya ca vikramāt yamābhyāṃ bhīmasenāc ca bhayaṃ me tāta jāyate
english: From the wrath of Yudhishthira, from the valor of Arjuna, from the twin sons of Yama, and from Bhimasena — fear arises in me, my son.

sanskrit: amānuṣaṃ manuṣyendrair jālaṃ vitatam antarā mama senāṃ haniṣyanti tataḥ krośāmi saṃjaya
english: A superhuman net spread in the midst — these lords of men will destroy my army. That is why I cry out, O Sanjaya.

sanskrit: darśanīyo manasvī ca lakṣmīvān brahmavarcasī medhāvī sukṛtaprajño dharmātmā pāṇḍunandanaḥ
english: Handsome, high-minded, radiant with prosperity, resplendent with brahmic lustre, wise, endowed with good judgment and understanding, righteous in soul — such is the son of Pandu.

sanskrit: mitrāmātyaiḥ susaṃpannaḥ saṃpanno yojyayojakaiḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ śvaśuraiḥ putrair upapanno mahārathaiḥ
english: Well endowed with friends and ministers, rich in those who wield and deploy resources, attended by brothers, fathers-in-law, and sons — all great warriors.

sanskrit: dhṛtyā ca puruṣavyāghro naibhṛtyena ca pāṇḍavaḥ anṛśaṃso vadānyaś ca hrīmān satyaparākramaḥ
english: That tiger among men, the son of Pandu, is possessed of steadfastness and modesty, free from cruelty, generous, possessed of a sense of shame, and true in his valor.

sanskrit: bahuśrutaḥ kṛtātmā ca vṛddhasevī jitendriyaḥ taṃ sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ samiddham iva pāvakam
english: Learned, self-disciplined, devoted to serving elders, master of his senses — him, endowed with all virtues, blazing like a kindled fire,

sanskrit: tapantam iva ko mandaḥ patiṣyati pataṃgavat pāṇḍavāgnim anāvāryaṃ mumūrṣur mūḍhacetanaḥ
english: scorching like the sun — what fool would fly into him like a moth into the Pandava fire, unstoppable, with a dull mind wishing for death?

sanskrit: tanur uccaḥ śikhī rājā śuddhajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ mandānāṃ mama putrāṇāṃ yuddhenāntaṃ kariṣyati
english: Slender, tall, crested, that king, radiant as pure gold, will put an end to my dull-witted sons in battle.

sanskrit: tair ayuddhaṃ sādhu manye kuravas tan nibodhata yuddhe vināśaḥ kṛtsnasya kulasya bhavitā dhruvam
english: I deem it right not to fight with them. Know this, O Kurus — in battle the destruction of the entire family will be certain.

sanskrit: eṣā me paramā śāntir yayā śāmyati me manaḥ yadi tv ayuddham iṣṭaṃ vo vayaṃ śāntyai yatāmahe
english: This is the highest peace for me, by which my mind is calmed. If peace without war is what you desire, then let us strive for reconciliation.

sanskrit: na tu naḥ śikṣamāṇānām upekṣeta yudhiṣṭhiraḥ jugupsati hy adharmeṇa mām evoddiśya kāraṇam
english: But Yudhishthira would not disregard us even as we implore — for he abhors unrighteousness and has me particularly as the cause of it.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca evam etan mahārāja yathā vadasi bhārata yuddhe vināśaḥ kṣatrasya gāṇḍīvena pradṛśyate
english: Sanjaya said: It is exactly as you say, O great king, O descendant of Bharata — the destruction of the warrior class through the Gandiva bow is clearly visible in battle.

sanskrit: idaṃ tu nābhijānāmi tava dhīrasya nityaśaḥ yat putravaśam āgaccheḥ sattvajñaḥ savyasācinaḥ
english: But this I do not understand about you, steadfast as you always are — that you, who know the true nature of things, have come under the sway of your son regarding the left-handed archer.

sanskrit: naiṣa kālo mahārāja tava śaśvat kṛtāgasaḥ tvayā hy evāditaḥ pārthā nikṛtā bharatarṣabha
english: This is not the time, O great king, for you who have always been the offender — for it was you yourself who first wronged the sons of Pritha, O bull among Bharatas.

sanskrit: pitā śreṣṭhaḥ suhṛd yaś ca samyak praṇihitātmavān āstheyaṃ hi hitaṃ tena na drogdhā gurur ucyate
english: A father is the best friend, and one who is properly focused in his inner self — his beneficial counsel should be followed. One who causes harm is not called a guardian.

sanskrit: idaṃ jitam idaṃ labdham iti śrutvā parājitān dyūtakāle mahārāja smayase sma kumāravat
english: "This is won, this is gained" — hearing these words while the Pandavas were defeated, at the time of the dice-game, O great king, you smiled like a child.

sanskrit: paruṣāṇy ucyamānāni purā pārthān upekṣase kṛtsnaṃ rājyaṃ jayantīti prapātaṃ nānupaśyasi
english: You overlooked the harsh words spoken to the sons of Pritha in former times, thinking "we are winning the entire kingdom," without seeing the abyss ahead.

sanskrit: pitryaṃ rājyaṃ mahārāja kuravas te sajāṅgalāḥ atha vīrair jitāṃ bhūmim akhilāṃ pratyapadyathāḥ
english: O great king, your Kurus with the Jangala region held the ancestral kingdom; then by means of heroes they won and occupied the entire earth.

sanskrit: bāhuvīryārjitā bhūmis tava pārthair niveditā mayedaṃ kṛtam ity eva manyase rājasattama
english: The earth won by the arm-strength of the Parthas was presented to you, and yet you think "I did this" — O best of kings.

sanskrit: grastān gandharvarājena majjato hy aplave 'mbhasi ānināya punaḥ pārthaḥ putrāṃs te rājasattama
english: Your sons who had been seized by the king of the Gandharvas and were sinking in waters without a raft — the son of Pritha brought them back again, O best of kings.

sanskrit: kumāravac ca smayase dyūte vinikṛteṣu yat pāṇḍaveṣu vanaṃ rājan pravrajatsu punaḥ punaḥ
english: And you smiled like a child when the Pandavas were cheated at dice and went into the forest again and again, O king.

sanskrit: pravarṣataḥ śaravrātān arjunasya śitān bahūn apy arṇavā viśuṣyeyuḥ kiṃ punar māṃsayonayaḥ
english: Of Arjuna raining down many sharp torrents of arrows — even oceans would dry up, let alone those born of flesh.

sanskrit: asyatāṃ phalgunaḥ śreṣṭho gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuṣāṃ varam keśavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam
english: Phalguna is the foremost among archers, the Gandiva the best of bows; Keshava is the foremost among all beings, and the Sudarshana the best of discs.

sanskrit: vānaro rocamānaś ca ketuḥ ketumatāṃ varaḥ evam etāni saratho vahañ śvetahayo raṇe kṣapayiṣyati no rājan kālacakram ivodyatam
english: The glowing monkey is the best of banners among the bannered. Bearing all these on his chariot with white horses in battle, O king, he will destroy us like a revolving wheel of time raised on high.

sanskrit: tasyādya vasudhā rājan nikhilā bharatarṣabha yasya bhīmārjunau yodhau sa rājā rājasattama
english: Today the entire earth belongs to him, O king, O bull among Bharatas — the king who has Bhima and Arjuna as his warriors. He is the best of kings.

sanskrit: tathā bhīmahataprāyāṃ majjantīṃ tava vāhinīm duryodhanamukhā dṛṣṭvā kṣayaṃ yāsyanti kauravāḥ
english: Likewise, seeing your army nearly slain by Bhima and sinking, the Kauravas led by Duryodhana will come to ruin.

sanskrit: na hi bhīmabhayād bhītā lapsyante vijayaṃ vibho tava putrā mahārāja rājānaś cānusāriṇaḥ
english: Struck with fear of Bhima, your sons, O great king, and the kings who follow them will not obtain victory, O lord.

sanskrit: matsyās tvām adya nārcanti pāñcālāś ca sakekayāḥ śālveyāḥ śūrasenāś ca sarve tvām avajānate pārthaṃ hy ete gatāḥ sarve vīryajñās tasya dhīmataḥ
english: The Matsyas do not honor you today, nor do the Panchalas together with the Kekayas; the Shalvas and the Shurasenas all disrespect you — for all these, knowing his valor, have gone over to the wise son of Pritha.

sanskrit: anarhān eva tu vadhe dharmayuktān vikarmaṇā sarvopāyair niyantavyaḥ sānugaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ tava putro mahārāja nātra śocitum arhasi
english: Those who do not deserve death yet act wrongfully through unrighteous deeds must be restrained by every means along with their followers — such an evil person is your son, O great king. You should not grieve over this.

sanskrit: dyūtakāle mayā coktaṃ vidureṇa ca dhīmatā yad idaṃ te vilapitaṃ pāṇḍavān prati bhārata anīśeneva rājendra sarvam etan nirarthakam
english: What was said by me and by the wise Vidura at the time of the dice-game — this lamentation of yours concerning the Pandavas, O descendant of Bharata, all of this is futile, like the cry of one who is powerless, O lord of kings.

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca na bhetavyaṃ mahārāja na śocyā bhavatā vayam samarthāḥ sma parān rājan vijetuṃ samare vibho
english: Duryodhana said: You must not be afraid, O great king, and you should not grieve for us. We are capable of defeating the enemies in battle, O king, O lord.

sanskrit: vanaṃ pravrājitān pārthān yad āyān madhusūdanaḥ mahatā balacakreṇa pararāṣṭrāvamardinā
english: When the sons of Pritha were exiled to the forest, Madhusudana came with a great wheel of forces capable of crushing enemy kingdoms.

sanskrit: kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuś ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ rājānaś cānvayuḥ pārthān bahavo 'nye 'nuyāyinaḥ
english: The Kekayas, Dhrishtaketu, and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata, and many other kings followed the sons of Pritha as their adherents.

sanskrit: indraprasthasya cādūrāt samājagmur mahārathāḥ vyagarhayaṃś ca saṃgamya bhavantaṃ kurubhiḥ saha
english: And those great warriors came from near Indraprastha, and having assembled, they censured you along with the Kurus.

sanskrit: te yudhiṣṭhiram āsīnam ajinaiḥ prativāsitam kṛṣṇapradhānāḥ saṃhatya paryupāsanta bhārata
english: They, with Krishna at their head, having gathered together, attended upon Yudhishthira as he sat clad in deer-skins, O descendant of Bharata.

sanskrit: pratyādānaṃ ca rājyasya kāryam ūcur narādhipāḥ bhavataḥ sānubandhasya samucchedaṃ cikīrṣavaḥ
english: The lords of men spoke of the necessity of recovering the kingdom, desiring to utterly destroy you along with your kinsmen.

sanskrit: śrutvā caitan mayoktās tu bhīṣmadroṇakṛpās tadā jñātikṣayabhayād rājan bhītena bharatarṣabha
english: Hearing this, Bhishma, Drona, and Kripa were then addressed by me, O king, as I was frightened by fear of the destruction of kinsmen, O bull among Bharatas.

sanskrit: na te sthāsyanti samaye pāṇḍavā iti me matiḥ samucchedaṃ hi naḥ kṛtsnaṃ vāsudevaś cikīrṣati
english: "The Pandavas will not abide by the agreement" — such is my conviction. For Vasudeva desires the complete destruction of us all.

sanskrit: ṛte ca viduraṃ sarve yūyaṃ vadhyā mahātmanaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca dharmajño na vadhyaḥ kurusattamaḥ
english: "Excepting Vidura, all of you deserve death at the hands of that great soul; and Dhritarashtra who knows dharma is not to be killed — he is the best of Kurus."

sanskrit: samucchedaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ naḥ kṛtvā tāta janārdanaḥ ekarājyaṃ kurūṇāṃ sma cikīrṣati yudhiṣṭhire
english: "And having utterly destroyed all of us, O father, Janardana wishes to establish the sole kingship of the Kurus in Yudhishthira."

sanskrit: tatra kiṃ prāptakālaṃ naḥ praṇipātaḥ palāyanam prāṇān vā saṃparityajya pratiyudhyāmahe parān
english: In that case, what is appropriate for us now — prostration, flight, or abandoning our lives and fighting back against the enemies?

sanskrit: pratiyuddhe tu niyataḥ syād asmākaṃ parājayaḥ yudhiṣṭhirasya sarve hi pārthivā vaśavartinaḥ
english: "In fighting back, our defeat would be certain, for all the kings are under the sway of Yudhishthira."

sanskrit: viraktarāṣṭrāś ca vayaṃ mitrāṇi kupitāni naḥ dhikkṛtāḥ pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ svajanena ca sarvaśaḥ
english: "We have a disaffected kingdom, our allies are angry with us, we are condemned by all the kings and by our own people on all sides."

sanskrit: praṇipāte tu doṣo 'sti bandhūnāṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ pitaraṃ tv eva śocāmi prajñānetraṃ janeśvaram matkṛte duḥkham āpannaṃ kleśaṃ prāptam anantakam
english: "But in prostration there is disgrace for kinsmen for all time." Yet I grieve only for my father, the lord of the people whose wisdom is his eyes — he has fallen into sorrow and endless affliction on my account.

sanskrit: kṛtaṃ hi tava putraiś ca pareṣām avarodhanam matpriyārthaṃ puraivaitad viditaṃ te narottama
english: For the obstruction of the enemies was carried out by your sons, and this was done for my sake — this was known to you before, O best of men.

sanskrit: te rājño dhṛtarāṣṭrasya sāmātyasya mahārathāḥ vairaṃ pratikariṣyanti kulocchedena pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Those mighty warriors, the Pandavas, will retaliate the enmity against King Dhritarashtra together with his ministers by destroying the family.

sanskrit: tato droṇo 'bravīd bhīṣmaḥ kṛpo drauṇiś ca bhārata matvā māṃ mahatīṃ cintām āsthitaṃ vyathitendriyam
english: Then Drona, Bhishma, Kripa, and the son of Drona spoke, O descendant of Bharata, perceiving that I was afflicted by great anxiety with my senses distressed.

sanskrit: abhidrugdhāḥ pare cen no na bhetavyaṃ paraṃtapa asamarthāḥ pare jetum asmān yudhi janeśvara
english: "If the enemies attack us, you must not be afraid, O scorcher of foes. The enemies are incapable of defeating us in battle, O lord of the people."

sanskrit: ekaikaśaḥ samarthāḥ smo vijetuṃ sarvapārthivān āgacchantu vineṣyāmo darpam eṣāṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
english: "Each of us individually is capable of conquering all the kings. Let them come — we will destroy their pride with our sharp arrows."

sanskrit: puraikena hi bhīṣmeṇa vijitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ mṛte pitary abhikruddho rathenaikena bhārata
english: "In former times, all the kings were conquered by Bhishma alone, enraged at his father's death, with a single chariot, O descendant of Bharata."

sanskrit: jaghāna subahūṃs teṣāṃ saṃrabdhaḥ kurusattamaḥ tatas te śaraṇaṃ jagmur devavratam imaṃ bhayāt
english: "That best of Kurus, enraged, slew very many of them; then they took refuge with this Devavrata out of fear."

sanskrit: sa bhīṣmaḥ susamartho 'yam asmābhiḥ sahito raṇe parān vijetuṃ tasmāt te vyetu bhīr bharatarṣabha ity eṣāṃ niścayo hy āsīt tatkālam amitaujasām
english: "This Bhishma, supremely capable, together with us in battle, will conquer the enemies. Therefore let your fear depart, O bull among Bharatas." This was indeed the firm conviction of those of immeasurable energy at that time.

sanskrit: purā pareṣāṃ pṛthivī kṛtsnāsīd vaśavartinī asmān punar amī nādya samarthā jetum āhave chinnapakṣāḥ pare hy adya vīryahīnāś ca pāṇḍavāḥ
english: "Formerly the whole earth was under the sway of the enemies; but now these men are not capable of defeating us in battle. For the Pandavas today have their wings clipped and are devoid of valor."

sanskrit: asmatsaṃsthā ca pṛthivī vartate bharatarṣabha ekārthāḥ sukhaduḥkheṣu mayānītāś ca pārthivāḥ
english: "The earth stands under our control, O bull among Bharatas; and the kings, united in purpose in pleasure and pain, have been brought over by me."

sanskrit: apy agniṃ praviśeyus te samudraṃ vā paraṃtapa madarthe pārthivāḥ sarve tad viddhi kurusattama
english: "Even into fire they would enter, or into the ocean, O scorcher of foes — all those kings for my sake. Know this, O best of Kurus."

sanskrit: unmattam iva cāpi tvāṃ prahasantīha duḥkhitam vilapantaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhītaṃ paravikatthane
english: "And here they laugh at you as if you were a madman — you who are distressed, lamenting in many ways, frightened, while the enemies boast."

sanskrit: eṣāṃ hy ekaikaśo rājñāṃ samarthaḥ pāṇḍavān prati ātmānaṃ manyate sarvo vyetu te bhayam āgatam
english: "For each one of these kings considers himself individually capable against the Pandavas. Let the fear that has come upon you depart."

sanskrit: sarvāṃ samagrāṃ senāṃ me vāsavo 'pi na śaknuyāt hantum akṣayyarūpeyaṃ brahmaṇāpi svayambhuvā
english: "Even Vasava could not slay my entire assembled army — this army of inexhaustible form — nor even Brahma the self-born."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiraḥ puraṃ hitvā pañca grāmān sa yācati bhīto hi māmakāt sainyāt prabhāvāc caiva me prabho
english: "Yudhishthira, having abandoned the city, begs for five villages — he is afraid of my army and of my power, O lord."

sanskrit: samarthaṃ manyase yac ca kuntīputraṃ vṛkodaram tan mithyā na hi me kṛtsnaṃ prabhāvaṃ vettha bhārata
english: "Whatever capability you attribute to the son of Kunti, Vrikodara — that is false. You do not know my full power, O descendant of Bharata."

sanskrit: matsamo hi gadāyuddhe pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaś cana nāsīt kaś cid atikrānto bhavitā na ca kaś cana
english: "For there is no one on earth equal to me in mace-fighting; there was no one in the past who surpassed me, and there will be no one in the future."

sanskrit: yukto duḥkhocitaś cāhaṃ vidyāpāragatas tathā tasmān na bhīmān nānyebhyo bhayaṃ me vidyate kva cit
english: "I am disciplined, accustomed to hardship, and one who has crossed to the far shore of knowledge. Therefore I have no fear anywhere — neither from Bhima nor from any others."

sanskrit: duryodhanasamo nāsti gadāyām iti niścayaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasya bhadraṃ te yat tadainam upāvasam
english: "There is no one equal to Duryodhana in the mace — this is the firm conviction of Samkarshana. Good for you that I attended upon him at that time."

sanskrit: yuddhe saṃkarṣaṇasamo balenābhyadhiko bhuvi gadāprahāraṃ bhīmo me na jātu viṣahed yudhi
english: "Equal to Samkarshana in battle, superior in strength on earth — Bhima could never endure my mace-blow in combat."

sanskrit: ekaṃ prahāraṃ yaṃ dadyāṃ bhīmāya ruṣito nṛpa sa evainaṃ nayed ghoraṃ kṣipraṃ vaivasvatakṣayam
english: "A single blow that I would deliver to Bhima in anger, O king — that alone would swiftly send him to the terrible realm of the son of Vivasvat."

sanskrit: iccheyaṃ ca gadāhastaṃ rājan draṣṭuṃ vṛkodaram suciraṃ prārthito hy eṣa mama nityaṃ manorathaḥ
english: "And I wish to see Vrikodara with mace in hand, O king — this has long been sought after and is ever the desire of my heart."

sanskrit: gadayā nihato hy ājau mama pārtho vṛkodaraḥ viśīrṇagātraḥ pṛthivīṃ parāsuḥ prapatiṣyati
english: "For slain by my mace in battle, that son of Pritha, Vrikodara, with his limbs shattered, will fall to the earth bereft of life."

sanskrit: gadāprahārābhihato himavān api parvataḥ sakṛn mayā viśīryeta giriḥ śatasahasradhā
english: "Even the Himalaya mountain, struck by my mace-blow once, would be shattered by me into a hundred thousand fragments."

sanskrit: sa cāpy etad vijānāti vāsudevārjunau tathā duryodhanasamo nāsti gadāyām iti niścayaḥ
english: "He too knows this, and so do Vasudeva and Arjuna — the firm conviction is that there is none equal to Duryodhana in the mace."

sanskrit: tat te vṛkodaramayaṃ bhayaṃ vyetu mahāhave vyapaneṣyāmy ahaṃ hy enaṃ mā rājan vimanā bhava
english: "Therefore let that fear of Vrikodara depart from you in the great battle — I will remove him. Do not be downcast, O king."

sanskrit: tasmin mayā hate kṣipram arjunaṃ bahavo rathāḥ tulyarūpā viśiṣṭāś ca kṣepsyanti bharatarṣabha
english: "When he is swiftly slain by me, many chariot-warriors equal and superior in form will assail Arjuna, O bull among Bharatas."

sanskrit: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ karṇo bhūriśravās tathā prāgjyotiṣādhipaḥ śalyaḥ sindhurājo jayadrathaḥ
english: "Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the son of Drona, Karna, Bhurishravas, the lord of Pragjyotisha, Shalya, and Jayadratha the king of the Sindhu —"

sanskrit: ekaika eṣāṃ śaktas tu hantuṃ bhārata pāṇḍavān samastās tu kṣaṇenaitān neṣyanti yamasādanam
english: "each one of these individually is capable of slaying the Pandavas, O descendant of Bharata; and together they will send them all to the abode of Yama in an instant."

sanskrit: samagrā pārthivī senā pārtham ekaṃ dhanaṃjayam kasmād aśaktā nirjetum iti hetur na vidyate
english: "That the entire army of kings is incapable of completely defeating Arjuna alone, the winner of wealth — there is no reason for that to be so."

sanskrit: śaravrātais tu bhīṣmeṇa śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ droṇadrauṇikṛpaiś caiva gantā pārtho yamakṣayam
english: "By Bhishma's torrents of arrows — hundreds and thousands of them — and by Drona, the son of Drona, and Kripa as well, the son of Pritha will go to the realm of Yama."
